Telmisartan potentiates the ITE-induced aryl hydrocarbon receptor activity in human liver cell line. Telmisartan is an angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) approved by the Food and Drug Administration of the US for the treatment of hypertension. It possesses unique pharmacologic properties, including the longest half-life among all ARBs; this leads to a 24-h sustained reduction of blood pressure.
